data.body: AC amendment: Add test case (f) for missing registry file — when RECIPE_REGISTRY_PATH points to a non-existent file, check-recipe-engines.sh must emit an error message to stderr and exit non-zero (consistent with consult-recipe-registry.sh pattern). Test: RECIPE_REGISTRY_PATH=/tmp/missing-registry-1779211514.yaml check-recipe-engines.sh expects: non-zero exit and stderr line containing 'registry not found' or 'Error:'.
